0022600034.text: The Knicks (6-5, 6-4 over their last ten, coming off a loss) visit the Pacers (4-8, 3-7 over their last ten, riding a win) in the 12th game of New York's season. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-110 win on March 17, 2026, in New York.
